messages:
jordana: Heads-up — Partner Z wants rolling SIEM exports into an EU bucket with 90-day retention. Our current export path sends to us-central and enforces 1y. Can we support region-restricted exports + EU KMS wrapping + redaction before export?

sanjay: We need to confirm: (1) EU KMS CMK for wrap/unwrap, (2) automated PII scrub (names, emails, IPs) with configable whitelist, (3) RBAC gating + audit trail.

elaine-privacy: +1 on whitelist. Also need DPI (data protection) sign-off and DPIA checklist filled before any export of EU-origin logs. Who owns that? @jordana

jordana: I can own the DPIA. Operational question: do we want to create a separate export pipeline or reuse existing with routing?

kevin (eng-infra): Prefer separate EU export pipeline to avoid cross-region copy and residency leak. Plan: export-service -> redaction lambda (containerized) -> EU KMS wrap -> s3-eu. RBAC: allow only `siem-exporters-eu` service account to push.

lina (oncall): Ops concerns: when an export job runs, SOC needs immediate visibility. Propose a webhook notification + permanent audit entry in the audit-log index (non-deletable). Also require JIT approval for ad-hoc exports.

jordana: JIT approval flow sounds right. UX: a ticket template that includes justification, TTL, recipient, and redaction profile. Example: `export: {recipient: partner-z, ttl_days:90, profile: pii-min}`

sanjay: For redaction we should avoid lossy regex only. Use multi-stage: structured field masks (json paths), deterministic tokenization for identifiers we need to retain for correlation, and full redaction for credentials. Document: `redaction_profile: [mask_email, token_ip, drop_passwords]`.

kevin (eng-infra): Sample RBAC snippet for the service account binding I propose: 
```yaml
bindings:
  - role: roles/siemExporter
    members:
      - serviceAccount:siem-exporters-eu@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
    condition:
      title: "JIT approved"
      expression: "request.time < timestamp_add(request.auth.claims.jit_expiry, 0)"
```

elaine-privacy: Also ensure exported data has an `export_id` and `dataset_hash` stored in audit with HMAC using an audit-only key so we can prove provenance.

ops-bot: export-job queued: id=ex-3421, pipeline=eu-redact, owner=jordana

lina (oncall): If a vuln/incident flags an exported file, escalation: (1) revoke export object's KMS grant, (2) revoke partner access, (3) snapshot object for forensics (read-only), (4) notify legal + privacy. Add this to runbook.

jordana: Action items: @kevin open infra PR for eu-redact pipeline + KMS CMK in eu, @sanjay draft redaction profiles & audit schema, @elaine complete DPIA. I'll draft ticket template and runbook skeleton.

kevin (eng-infra): Will do. ETA PR by EOD tomorrow.

jordana: Thanks everyone. Once PR exists we'll schedule a dry-run with a synthetic export and SOC verification. :thumbsup:
